tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The kit's Primary/Accent global color (Elementor kit-6). Default button label and icon color, active heading accents, header gradient's left stop, hover state for buttons and the mobile menu toggle. On `surface`: ~5.08:1 (passes AA for normal text and UI).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: The kit's Secondary global color. Header gradient's right stop, arrow-hover accents, secondary button hover. Not used for body text (fails AA on white — decorative/surface use only).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The kit's Text global color. Default body copy on `surface` and `surface-raised`. ~17.9:1 (passes AAA).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background; also the kit's white global color (used as button fill, dropdown-panel fill, and — at partial opacity — button/nav text on colored grounds).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Card and tile backgrounds set apart from `surface` (the six product-line cards on Home, nav-dropdown hover rows). Real kit color, confirmed in use.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: A third neutral defined in the site's color kit alongside `surface-raised`, not seen applied on the pages captured — reserve for a light divider or inactive-state fill if one is needed; verify against the live site before relying on it.

tokens.name: on-header
tokens.usage: Header nav-item default text/icon color, rendered at ~60% opacity (`#FFFFFF99`) over the header's gradient — see `Header`. Full white on hover/active/focus.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: H1 / hero headline (e.g. "Christian Crawford – premium cleanliness"). Site's real responsive steps: 80/70/60/50/40/30px from desktop down to mobile.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings ("Christian Crawford product line", "History and mission"). Real responsive steps: 56/48/42/36/28/24px.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card and sub-section titles. Real responsive steps: 32/30/28/25/22/20px.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Heading-widget default (most in-page headings use this level). Real responsive steps: 28/26/24/22/20/18px.

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: Minor headings, product/news card titles. Real responsive steps: 20/19/17/14px.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default paragraph copy — the kit's sitewide base text style. Does not scale by breakpoint.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav items and form labels/inputs share this exact spec (text-transform: none). Does not scale by breakpoint.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tightest real gap value seen between closely related elements.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Compact stacks — label to input, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: The site's most common flex/grid gap — card grids, button padding (12px 24px).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between larger card groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section-level container padding (top/bottom).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Wide gaps between major page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Largest real gap seen, used sparingly between hero-scale sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Form inputs and textareas.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The nav dropdown panel.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Product-line cards and tiles — the site's most common card radius (confirmed on all six Home category cards).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Occasional large feature blocks/images.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button on the site (not a generic 999px — the kit's own literal value).

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Circular elements (icon badges).
